comment: No-regression ceiling for `pnpm typecheck:ci` (tsconfig.typecheck.json, full renderer). Lower this as the backlog shrinks; never raise it. Goal: 0. TEMPORARILY 3 (was 0): the pnpm migration's isolated node_modules exposed a pre-existing collision between the two coexisting Plate generations — GetParamKeyApi is defined only in jotai-x@2.3.3 (used by platejs@52/@platejs/*@51) while @udecode/plate-core@39 uses jotai-x@1.2.4. Yarn's flat tree hoisted one copy so the store accessor types lined up by accident. No override fixes this; pinning either jotai-x breaks the other generation. The 3 errors are all in components/plate-ui (image-element, media-embed-element, plate-element) and go away with the planned removal of the @udecode/plate v39 generation. Return this to 0 then.
